chunks.title: KV Cache avoids recomputing previous attention states
aliases: KV Cache reuses key and value states
chunks.concept: Autoregressive decoding repeatedly attends to earlier tokens. KV Cache stores the key and value tensors already computed for those tokens so each decoding step only computes the new token's states.
chunks.problem: Without reuse, the model recomputes attention states for the entire prefix at every generation step.
chunks.mechanism: Each transformer layer appends the new token's key and value tensors to a cache and reads the accumulated tensors during attention.
chunks.why_it_matters: It substantially reduces repeated inference work, while introducing memory capacity and memory-bandwidth constraints.
chunks.example: When generating token 101, the model reuses cached states for tokens 1–100 and computes only token 101's new key and value.

connections.note: Cache size grows with context length.
